review_evidence: The unit contains 184 primary Lean files implementing LogicQ/ChainQ, type-checking, compiler IRs and lowerings, QASM and surface front ends, QStab/QClifford targets, code switching, lattice-surgery machinery, simulation, and supporting formal specifications.

The README describes the repository as a tower of small languages with syntax, semantics, checkers, and kernel-checked lowering soundness; the checked examples and test modules are part of those language contracts.

Direct inspection of Compiler/QASM/AuditTests.lean confirms test-labelled material defines reusable fixtures and many kernel-checked behavioral propositions, so test/audit naming is not a safe exclusion boundary. No stronger exact content-level exclusion invariant was found for any primary file.
summary: Retain LogicQ's verified QEC languages, compiler passes, checkers, semantics, regression specifications, and examples.
